description: Dubai-born premium gym and performance-wear brand for men and women, founded by Anam and Wajdan with the stated aim of building the first global apparel brand from the Middle East. In January 2026 it launched its first formal global affiliate programme on CJ Affiliate, aimed at content creators and gym communities.

evidence.summary: Campaign Middle East (22 Jan 2026) reports SQUATWOLF 'is launching its first ever global affiliate marketing network programme' on the CJ Affiliate (CJ) network, led by its E-commerce and Digital Director and aimed at a curated publisher ecosystem including content creators and gym communities; the brand calls it 'our first strong rep towards that' — a brand-new programme, which is the basis for the low-saturation mark.

Shopper's SQUATWOLF partnership listing states 'The Squatwolf affiliate program offers a payout rate of 5%' and describes the brand as 'Premium Gym Wear, Born & Designed in Dubai, UAE'; CompareEPC's activewear table independently lists SQUATWOLF on CJ at 5%. No cap statement is published anywhere fetched, so the cap is honestly unknown.
SQUATWOLF's official Our Story page describes the brand being built in Dubai by founders Anam and Wajdan, 'building the first global apparel brand from the Middle East' from a small Dubai apartment.

name: SQUATWOLF

reasons.compensation: 5% per sale per two independent listings — modest but published; no cap statement anywhere, so the cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Joining runs through the CJ programme listing; no published partnerships email was verified on a fetched page.
reasons.credibility: Established Dubai premium activewear brand covered by trade press for its affiliate launch.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium gym apparel for men and women — squarely in the fitness-creator niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The programme launched in January 2026 and is actively recruiting its first publisher cohort.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal affiliate programme explicitly courting content creators and gym communities, though only just launched.

description: Canadian-founded strength-equipment retailer established in 2010 by Kaevon Khoozani, selling power racks, barbells, plates, benches, cable machines and kettlebells for home gyms in Canada and the US. Its own affiliate programme terms state the program is intended for content creators and fitness influencers.

evidence.summary: The brand's own affiliate portal terms state 'This program is intended for actual content creators and fitness influencers'; affiliates must have PayPal, payouts are monthly with a $100 minimum balance, and coupon sites and dropshippers are not permitted. The portal publishes terms but no commission percentage, and no cap statement, so the cap is honestly unknown.

CompareEPC's affiliate database lists Bells Of Steel on Impact at 5% commission with a $5.31 EPC — the only published rate found; Sovrn's merchant page states its own rate 'could not be independently verified', so the 5% is recorded as publicly reported, not brand-published.

Sovrn describes Bells of Steel as a Canadian-founded strength-equipment retailer established in 2010 by Kaevon Khoozani, with operations serving Canada and the United States; the brand's official About page says it grew from selling competition-grade kettlebells from a car trunk to a team of 80.

name: Bells of Steel

reasons.compensation: 5% per the only published listing (CompareEPC, via Impact); the brand's own portal publishes no rate, so this stays low-mid.
reasons.contact_access: Published support and commercial emails on official pages plus the brand's own affiliate portal — good access, though no dedicated partnerships email.
reasons.credibility: Founded in 2010 with Canada and US operations and a team of 80 per its official About page.
reasons.niche_fit: Home-gym strength equipment is a core, fast-growing fitness-creator niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open through the brand's own affiliate portal today.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Official programme terms explicitly target content creators and fitness influencers, with clear payout rules.

description: Los Angeles-based fitness, streetwear and lifestyle apparel brand founded in 2014 by brothers Garry and Robby Chopra, with a women's line (YoungLA for Her, launched 2022). CreatorIQ describes it as an affiliate-driven DTC fitness apparel brand whose top creators share personalised discount codes and affiliate links.

evidence.summary: CreatorIQ's research (Mar 2025) reports: 'Affiliate codes are a hallmark of YoungLA's top-performing content... In 2024, posts mentioning an affiliate code powered $245.7M EMV — more than half of YoungLA's $431.7M EMV total.' No commission percentage is published anywhere fetched, so the rate is recorded as null and the cap as unknown.

The same CreatorIQ study states: 'Of all the 100 brands on that list, YoungLA claimed, by far, the smallest creator count' despite ranking No. 50 for total engagements in 2024 — 2.3K creators in 2024, with 669 core creators powering $284.8M EMV. That published creator count, the smallest among peer top-100 engagement brands, is the basis for the low-saturation mark; the absolute core cohort is still in the hundreds.

YoungLA's official About Us page states it was founded in Los Angeles in 2014, describes 'a global fitness and lifestyle brand reaching millions through our products, athletes, creators', publishes a questions phone number, and links its Instagram (instagram.com/youngla) and TikTok (tiktok.com/@youngla) profiles. No public affiliate application page or email is published on the fetched official pages.

Creator saturation re-judged to 'unknown' by the batch coordinator: the CreatorIQ figure (2.3K creators in 2024, smallest on its 100-brand engagement list) is a relative mark; by the standard applied across batches (492 creators judged too high to call low), 2.3K creators is not verified-low in absolute terms.

name: YoungLA

reasons.compensation: No commission rate is published anywhere fetched, so this stays low per the rubric despite the programme's scale.
reasons.contact_access: No public application page or published partnerships email; only a phone number on the official About page.
reasons.credibility: Major DTC fitness apparel brand with $431.7M earned media value in 2024 per CreatorIQ.
reasons.niche_fit: Fitness and streetwear apparel is a top creator niche, with a women's line since 2022.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The programme runs on personalised creator codes with no public application route found, so availability scores low.
reasons.ugc_evidence: One of the most documented creator-affiliate models in fitness: affiliate-code posts powered over half of the brand's 2024 EMV.

description: Fashion footwear and clothing brand built on an on-demand production system and responsible-fashion positioning. evidence.summary: ALOHAS' official affiliates page ('JOIN ALOHAS AFFILIATE PROGRAM') states affiliates 'enjoy exclusive perks, including up to 15% CPA for tailored campaigns, complimentary ALOHAS products to test', alongside '10% Average CPA managed', '+395 Facilitated orders', '+$9,000 Earned in commissions' and '$174 AOV Achieved'.

The same page publishes programme terms — a 30-day cookie, rewards for first-time buyers only, payouts with a 2-month delay at a EUR 50 minimum balance — and invites contact with 'the ALOHAS partnerships team at affiliates@alohas.com'. The page does not name its network and publishes no cap statement, so the cap is honestly unknown.
